name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled cluster-local virtual hosts, including static content, firewalling, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development certificate generation.

name: cache
description: Sets up Memcached and Redis services, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and cleanup of selected replication-related configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application backed by PostgreSQL, including Python tooling, source checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, database and user creation, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
